title: Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Flutter Developer with 2–3 years of experience to join our mobile app development team. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining high\-quality cross\-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS using Flutter. You will work closely with designers, backend developers, and project teams to build reliable and user\-focused mobile applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
* Build responsive and high\-performance applications for Android and iOS.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to convert designs into functional mobile applications.
* Work with backend developers to integrate APIs and third\-party services.
* Write clean, scalable, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Integrate third\-party APIs, SDKs, payment gateways, Firebase services, and other required services.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.
* Participate in code reviews and team discussions.
* Improve application performance, security, and user experience.
* Test applications across different devices and operating systems.
* Stay updated with Flutter, Dart, and mobile development technologies.

**Required Skills**

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in Flutter development.
* Strong knowledge of Dart programming language.
* Good understanding of Flutter widgets, architecture, and app lifecycle.
* Experience with state management tools such as Provider, BLoC, Riverpod, or similar solutions.
* Experience in RESTful API integration.
* Knowledge of Firebase services.
* Understanding of mobile application architecture and development best practices.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Attention to code quality and application performance.

**Tools and Technologies**

* Flutter
* Dart
* Firebase
* RESTful APIs
* Provider, BLoC, Riverpod, or similar state management tools
* Git and Git\-based version control platforms
* Android Studio
* VS Code
* Postman
* Google Play Console
* Apple App Store Connect
* Third\-party APIs and SDKs

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of professional experience in Flutter mobile application development.
* Experience in developing and deploying Android and iOS applications.
* Experience in publishing applications to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store is preferred.
* A portfolio of completed mobile applications will be an advantage.

**What We Expect**

* Take ownership of assigned mobile application projects and tasks.
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Deliver tasks within agreed timelines.
* Communicate clearly with team members and project stakeholders.
* Be open to feedback and actively participate in code reviews.
* Identify and resolve technical issues independently.
* Follow coding standards and development processes.
* Stay updated with new Flutter and mobile development technologies.
* Contribute ideas that improve the quality and functionality of our mobile applications.

**Location Requirement**

* Kerala\-based candidates only

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month
